appDescription: An in-car routine app that runs the driver's saved car routines and lists them.

function.name: START_ROUTINE
function.description: Runs one of the driver's saved routines now, by its name, while the car is parked.

routineName.description: Name of the saved routine to run.

function.name: SET_ROUTINE_ENABLED
function.description: Turns one of the driver's saved routines on or off, by its name.

routineName.description: Name of the saved routine to turn on or off.

enabled.description: True to turn the routine on, false to turn it off.

function.name: GET_ROUTINES
function.description: Lists the driver's saved routines with whether each is on.
